Container.Name: kopia-sync-status
Container.Overview: Tiny static-file server exposing the Kopia-to-Backblaze-B2 sync status. The nightly kopia_sync_b2 Unraid User Script runs a `kopia repository sync-to --dry-run` verification after every sync and writes the result (in_sync / cleanup_pending / behind / error, blob counts, last-checked time) to sync-b2-status.json in this container's mounted folder. This container just serves that one file over plain HTTP so the Homepage dashboard's "Kopia Local - Sources 2/2" tile can poll it. No image build needed - reuses the glances image only for its python3 runtime; the container's own CMD is overridden to run python's http.server instead of Glances.
Container.Requires: Requires the kopia_sync_b2 Unraid User Script to be writing sync-b2-status.json into the mounted path below - this container only serves the file, it does not generate it.

Config.Name: Status Folder
Config.Description: Folder containing sync-b2-status.json, written nightly by kopia_sync_b2
